crossRefs.note: “Declare among the nations and publish, and set up a standard; publish, and don’t conceal: say, ‘Babylon has been…
For a nation comes up out of the north against her, which will make her land desolate, and no one will dwell in it.…
For, behold, I will stir up and cause to come up against Babylon a company of great nations from the north country; and…
Yahweh says, “Behold, a people comes from the north country. A great nation will be stirred up from the uttermost parts…
They take hold of bow and spear. They are cruel, and have no mercy. Their voice roars like the sea, and they ride on…
For many nations and great kings will make bondservants of them, even of them. I will recompense them according to…
Yahweh says: “Behold, I will raise up against Babylon, and against those who dwell in Lebkamai, a destroying wind.
I will send to Babylon strangers, who will winnow her. They will empty her land; for in the day of trouble they will be…
“Make the arrows sharp! Hold the shields firmly! Yahweh has stirred up the spirit of the kings of the Medes, because…
“Set up a standard in the land! Blow the trumpet among the nations! Prepare the nations against her! Call together…
Prepare against her the nations, the kings of the Medes, its governors, and all its deputies, and all the land of their…
Set up a banner on the bare mountain! Lift up your voice to them! Wave your hand, that they may go into the gates of…
Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, who will not value silver, and as for gold, they will not delight in it.
Their bows will dash the young men in pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb. Their eyes will not…
The ten horns which you saw, and the beast, these will hate the prostitute, will make her desolate, will strip her…

translations.web: “Behold, a people comes from the north; and a great nation and many kings will be stirred up from the uttermost parts of the earth.
translations.bsb: Behold, an army is coming from the north; a great nation and many kings are stirred up from the ends of the earth.
translations.kjv: Behold, a people shall come from the north, and a great nation, and many kings shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth.
translations.asv: Behold, a people cometh from the north; and a great nation and many kings shall be stirred up from the uttermost parts of the earth.
